description: Create or update MANY nodes in one call — the bulk form of create_node. ALL OF IT OR NONE OF IT: every item is attempted so you learn every failure in one round trip, and if anything failed nothing is written. Upsert, like create_node, so re-running after a fix is safe.

props.description:
Property object; validated against the schema exactly as `create_node`
validates it.

check_only.description:
Validate every item and WRITE NOTHING. The reply says whether the batch
would have applied and lists every failure, so a large batch is fixed
once and sent once instead of resent whole after each rejection.

name: create_nodes
